blurb: A boutique release of just six private-pool sea-view villas on a palm-clad hillside near Nathon, on Koh Samui’s quiet west coast — only two still available. Each villa has its own infinity plunge pool framing the Gulf, and is fully managed within the resort hotel programme — generating passive income while owners enjoy the property whenever they choose. A guaranteed 10% ROI for the first five years; ฿7,500,000, completing December 2026.
detail:
A limited collection of only six private-pool villas set into a green hillside above the west coast of Koh Samui, close to Nathon — a calmer, more local stretch of the island that stays well connected to everywhere else (around 15 minutes to Lipa Noi Beach, 30 to Fisherman’s Village and 40 to Chaweng and the airport).

Each single-level villa is conceived for tropical indoor-outdoor living — glass walls slide back to dissolve the line between the living pavilion and a private infinity plunge pool that looks out over the palms to the sea and the island’s sunsets. The architecture is restrained and contemporary, finished in natural stone and warm timber.

What makes this a smart investment as much as a retreat is the management: every villa is operated as part of the resort hotel programme, with housekeeping, cleaning and pool maintenance held to five-star resort standards, so the home earns consistently and transparently while sitting ready for the owner whenever they visit. Owners also enjoy the resort’s facilities at exclusive partner rates.

The developer offers a guaranteed 10% return on investment for the first five years. Of the six villas, only two remain available, each priced at ฿7,500,000 (Thai Baht, excluding legal and transfer fees). All villas complete in December 2026.

Estimated nightly rental rates
Low season — ฿7,000–8,800
High season — ฿10,500–12,500
Peak season — ฿15,000–16,000

Detail terms
Ownership Structure — 30-Year Leasehold
Personal Usage — 60 Days per Year
Booking Privilege — Partner Rate (exclusive discounted access)
Guaranteed ROI — 10% per annum, first 5 years
Management Fee — 35% (all-inclusive)

This is part of the expansion plan for an existing four-star resort that has been operating for over a year — already showing strong profit and good reviews, so you know the team understands how to run the business. It's a completely hands-off investment.
